# Adaline — Style Reference

> Moss-tinted field notebook clipped over an oil-painted valley. Akkurat headlines at weight 400 sit on #fbfdf6 linen, hairlines are 10%-alpha moss, and one forest-green pill is the only filled control you can press.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Adaline speaks a moss-tinted instrument-log language. Every neutral on the page has been steeped in green: the #fbfdf6 Linen Canvas, the #f8f9f5 Paper Card, the #e9ede9 Sage Wash tiles and the #0a1d08 Forest Ink headlines all carry the tint, so no true gray survives anywhere. The chromatic budget is two saturated hues, #2b6b5e Pine Signal and #991e4b Ember Signal. Both live inside product mockups as status marks, and neither appears in the marketing chrome. The only filled action is the near-black #203b14 Forest Fill. Typography splits into two voices. Akkurat at weight 400 carries 53px headlines with -0.04em tracking and 18px body copy. Fragment Mono has 618 measured uses against roughly 430 for the sans, and it runs every button, nav link, label and readout at 9 to 14px. Hierarchy comes from size jumps near 1.7x, not from weight. Actions are pills, cards take 12px corners, and real shadows are reserved for floating mockups. The page reads as a field botanist's lab notebook rather than a SaaS dashboard.

| Ember Signal | `#991e4b` | `--color-ember-signal` | ERR and ISSUE badges, failure ratios and 1px alert rings (43 uses). This is the only warm hue in the system. Keep it strictly diagnostic, never decorative. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Akkurat — the display and prose voice, quiet at every size · `--font-akkurat`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 420 (variable axis), Geist at 400, Public Sans at 400. Akkurat's 400 draws slightly sturdier and wider than Inter's 400, so nudge Inter up rather than down. Do not use Inter at 300, which reads visibly anaemic at 53px.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 700
- **Sizes:** 8px, 9px, 10px, 11px, 12px, 13px, 14px, 18px, 30px, 53px
- **Line height:** 1.11 to 1.44 (1.21 display, 1.16 heading, 1.44 body)
- **Letter spacing:** -2.12px at 53px (-0.04em); -0.6px at 30px (-0.02em); 0.9px at 9px uppercase labels (0.1em); 0px at 18px and below
- **OpenType features:** `calt`, `kern`
- **Role:** Weight 400 at 53px is the signature. The headline is large and soft-spoken, and it earns authority through scale and -0.04em tightening instead of boldness, which is anti-convention for a developer-tools hero. The steps 18 → 30 → 53 run at roughly 1.67 and 1.77. That is far steeper than a Perfect Fourth (1.333), so the scale skips middle levels and lets three sizes do all the prose work. Weight 500 and 700 appear only at 9 to 11px inside mockups, where small text needs extra density.

### Fragment Mono — the instrument voice for every control, label and readout · `--font-fragment-mono`

- **Substitute:** Fragment Mono at 400 (freely licensed, so use the original), Geist Mono at 400, DM Mono at 400. Fragment Mono draws light and narrow. Avoid IBM Plex Mono at 400, which reads a full step heavier at 9px.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 8px, 8.5px, 9px, 9.5px, 10px, 10.5px, 11px, 14px
- **Line height:** 1.0 to 1.3 (1.0 on 14px buttons, 1.11 at 9px, 1.27 at 11px)
- **Letter spacing:** 0.09px at 9px (0.01em); 0.2px at 10px; 0.21px at 10.5px; 0.22px at 11px inputs; 1.1px at 11px uppercase section labels (0.1em); 0.28px at 14px nav and buttons (0.02em)
- **OpenType features:** `calt`, `kern`
- **Role:** With 618 measured uses, the monospace is the most frequent face on the page. Buttons, nav, footer headings and every mockup readout speak in typewriter cadence. That inverts the usual marketing convention, where mono is reserved for code blocks. The constant positive tracking (0.01 to 0.1em) keeps the narrow glyphs legible at 8 to 10px, and it makes uppercase labels read as stamped instrument plates.

### GT America Mono — mockup-internal tabular figures · `--font-gt-america-mono`

- **Substitute:** Roboto Mono at 400, JetBrains Mono at 400. GT America Mono is a grotesk mono with sturdier strokes than Fragment Mono, and both substitutes match that density at 10px.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 10px
- **Line height:** 1.2
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at 10px
- **Role:** It appears 30 times, only inside product mockups, for timestamps and costs such as "10:03:17" and "$0.10". It is a second mono chosen for tabular steadiness rather than voice. Treat it as mockup-internal: never use it in marketing chrome. A 300-weight Newsreader serif also appears four times as a decorative flourish and is not a system face.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Fragment Mono | 400 | 9px | 1.11 | 0.09px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Fragment Mono | 400 | 11px | 1.27 | 1.1px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Akkurat | 400 | 13px | 1.23 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Fragment Mono | 400 | 14px | 1.0 | 0.28px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Akkurat | 400 | 18px | 1.44 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| heading | Akkurat | 400 | 30px | 1.16 | -0.6px | `--text-heading` |
| display | Akkurat | 400 | 53px | 1.21 | -2.12px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Tint every neutral green, from #fbfdf6 canvas to #0a1d08 ink — the botanical cast is the system's identity, and it must survive into every new gray you add.
- Set headlines in Akkurat weight 400 at 53px with -2.12px tracking — scale and tightening carry authority, so the face never has to shout.
- Put every button, nav link and label in Fragment Mono at 9 to 14px with 0.01 to 0.1em tracking — the monospace is the interface voice, not a code-block garnish.
- Keep #203b14 Forest Fill as the one filled action, on a 20px-radius pill — a single dark pill per viewport is non-negotiable for the calm hierarchy.
- Confine #2b6b5e and #991e4b to status badges, bars and 1px rings inside mockups — the two-hue budget means color always signals state.
- Draw dividers as 1px #2e43201a Moss Hairline — a 10%-alpha ink line stays in the same family as the text it separates.
- Float product mockups on 1280px painted frames with the md shadow and a 12px radius — art behind, instrument in front, is the page's narrative unit.

### Don't

- Don't introduce a cool true gray such as #6b7280 (not a system token) for captions — it breaks the chlorophyll cast instantly, and the page should never contain an untinted neutral.
- Don't bold the 30px or 53px headlines to 700 — weight 700 exists only at 9 to 11px inside mockups, and heavy display type turns the notebook into a billboard.
- Don't fill a CTA with #2b6b5e Pine Signal because it looks like "the brand green" — that hue means LIVE and PASS, and spending it on actions erases its diagnostic meaning.
- Don't set button labels in Akkurat at 14px sentence case — the Fragment Mono uppercase 0.28px voice is what makes controls read as instrument switches.
- Don't apply the md card shadow to section intros, logos or tags — elevation is reserved for the 785px mockup card, and spreading it flattens the hierarchy.
- Don't swap the painted landscapes for gradients or mesh blobs — the backdrops are artwork with brushwork, and a synthetic gradient would read as generic AI-startup chrome.
- Don't square the corners of buttons to 4px — actions are 20px pills while 4px belongs to inner tiles, and mixing them blurs which shapes are pressable.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #fbfdf6 (Linen Canvas)
- card surface: #f8f9f5 (Paper Card)
- headline text: #0a1d08 (Forest Ink)
- body text: #6b7860 (Sage Caption)
- UI text: #2e4320 (Moss Text)
- hairline: #2e43201a (Moss Hairline)
- status: #2b6b5e (Pine Signal) and #991e4b (Ember Signal)
- primary action: #203b14 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts default to #e9ede9 Sage Wash bars and Moss Text at 40% opacity for sparklines. #2b6b5e and #991e4b may appear only as 1 to 2px strokes, small dots, or 12%-opacity fills that mark pass and fail states, so data never outshouts the 53px headline.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an inline-flex anchor 32px tall with 0 14px padding, background #203b14, text #fbfdf6, no border, border-radius 20px, and no shadow. Set the label in Fragment Mono 400 at 14px, uppercase, line-height 1.0 and letter-spacing 0.28px. For the hero variant, raise the height to 40px with the same 20px radius. Place a ghost twin 8px to the right with a transparent background, a 1px solid #c5ccb6 border, #2e4320 text and identical type and radius.

2. Build a hero section on #fbfdf6, max-width 1280px, two columns. In the left 640px column, stack these items. First, a pill tag with background #e9ede9, text #2e4320, Fragment Mono 400 11px uppercase with 1.1px letter-spacing, 4px 8px padding and a 9999px radius. Second, 24px below it, an H1 in Akkurat 400 at 53px with line-height 1.21, letter-spacing -2.12px and color #0a1d08. Third, 24px below the headline, a paragraph in Akkurat 400 18px with line-height 1.44, color #6b7860 and max-width 640px. Fourth, 40px below the paragraph, the primary and ghost pills. In the right 400px column, render a grid of random punctuation in Fragment Mono 400 at 9px with line-height 1.11, letter-spacing 0.09px and color #2e4320 at 40% opacity.

3. Build a feature section. Start with a left-aligned H2 in Akkurat 400 at 30px with line-height 1.16, letter-spacing -0.6px and color #0a1d08. Add a 12px gap, then an 18px #6b7860 lede capped at 746px. Below it, 24px down, place a 1280px-wide frame with a 6px radius and a landscape oil-painting background image. Center a 785×615px card on it with background #f8f9f5, a 12px radius, 0 padding, and box-shadow `0 0 0 1px rgba(52,79,49,0.07), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9), 0 12px 32px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2), 0 4px 10px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)`. Inside the card, rows use 6px 8px padding with 1px #2e43201a dividers, and the bottom status bar is #1d2226 with #d8e3dd Fragment Mono 9px text.

4. Build a sticky navigation bar 64px tall with background #fbfdf6, no border and no shadow, with inner content capped at 1280px. Place an 18px-tall #0a1d08 wordmark on the left. On the right, add the links DOCS and BLOG in Fragment Mono 400 14px uppercase with 0.28px letter-spacing, color #2e4320 and 8px 12px padding, then a 32px-tall pill with background #203b14, text #fbfdf6, 0 14px padding and a 20px radius.

It sits 8px to the right of the primary pill and matches its geometry exactly. Pairing the two by stroke alone keeps the chromatic budget untouched while still offering a second action.

### Navigation Bar

**Role:** Sticky top rail with mono links

A thin linen strip. The spec is a sticky bar 64px tall on a #fbfdf6 Linen Canvas fill, with no bottom border and no shadow, constrained to 1280px. The 18px-tall Forest Ink #0a1d08 wordmark sits on the left. On the right are the DOCS and BLOG links in Fragment Mono uppercase at 14px weight 400, 0.28px tracking and 8px 12px padding, followed by the dark 32px Get Started pill. Three items and no dropdowns make the bar feel like a terminal title bar rather than a SaaS mega-menu.

**Role:** Hero kicker above the headline

A small stamped plate. A typographic texture field. The spec is a 400px-wide column of random punctuation (`?&_!~*/=;#@|`) set in Fragment Mono at 9px weight 400, line height 1.11 and 0.09px tracking. Left-aligned and narrow. The decorative outlier. A floating instrument window. Tiny and rationed. The spec is a 3px radius with no border and 2px 4px padding, set in Fragment Mono uppercase at 9px weight 400 with 0.09px tracking and a leading ● dot. **Role:** Social proof marquee

Monochrome and unboxed. **Role:** Footer workflow sequence

The inverted system outlier. ## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Tint every neutral green, from #fbfdf6 canvas to #0a1d08 ink — the botanical cast is the system's identity, and it must survive into every new gray you add.
- Set headlines in Akkurat weight 400 at 53px with -2.12px tracking — scale and tightening carry authority, so the face never has to shout.
- Put every button, nav link and label in Fragment Mono at 9 to 14px with 0.01 to 0.1em tracking — the monospace is the interface voice, not a code-block garnish.
- Keep #203b14 Forest Fill as the one filled action, on a 20px-radius pill — a single dark pill per viewport is non-negotiable for the calm hierarchy.
- Confine #2b6b5e and #991e4b to status badges, bars and 1px rings inside mockups — the two-hue budget means color always signals state.
- Draw dividers as 1px #2e43201a Moss Hairline — a 10%-alpha ink line stays in the same family as the text it separates.
- Float product mockups on 1280px painted frames with the md shadow and a 12px radius — art behind, instrument in front, is the page's narrative unit.

### Don't

- Don't introduce a cool true gray such as #6b7280 (not a system token) for captions — it breaks the chlorophyll cast instantly, and the page should never contain an untinted neutral.
- Don't bold the 30px or 53px headlines to 700 — weight 700 exists only at 9 to 11px inside mockups, and heavy display type turns the notebook into a billboard.
- Don't fill a CTA with #2b6b5e Pine Signal because it looks like "the brand green" — that hue means LIVE and PASS, and spending it on actions erases its diagnostic meaning.
- Don't set button labels in Akkurat at 14px sentence case — the Fragment Mono uppercase 0.28px voice is what makes controls read as instrument switches.
- Don't apply the md card shadow to section intros, logos or tags — elevation is reserved for the 785px mockup card, and spreading it flattens the hierarchy.
- Don't swap the painted landscapes for gradients or mesh blobs — the backdrops are artwork with brushwork, and a synthetic gradient would read as generic AI-startup chrome.
- Don't square the corners of buttons to 4px — actions are 20px pills while 4px belongs to inner tiles, and mixing them blurs which shapes are pressable.

## Imagery

Imagery comes in three registers, and none of them is photography. The first is impressionist oil-painted landscapes: a sunlit canyon with a cliffside town, and a lavender snowfield with tiny walking figures. They fill 1280px frames with a 6px radius, no border and no shadow. The second is dense product mockups at 785px on #f8f9f5 cards with a 12px radius and the md shadow, floating centered on those paintings. The third is a hero ASCII glyph field in Fragment Mono at 40%-opacity Moss Text. Icons are thin-stroke line glyphs at 24px inside 4px-radius hit areas. The site uses no gradients, orbs or glows as system tokens. The single mint glow is decorative only. The narrative is precise machinery set inside a slow, painted landscape, and the agent is shown as something that grows on its own.

## Layout

The page caps at 1280px, centered on #fbfdf6, with a sticky 64px nav: wordmark left, DOCS, BLOG and the dark pill right, filled with linen and unbordered. The hero is two columns: a 640px text stack on the left (eyebrow, 53px headline, 18px lede, two pills) and a 400px ASCII field on the right. A centered TRUSTED BY label and a single marquee row of eight logos follow. Each feature section then repeats one unit: a left-aligned 746px intro block, 24px of space, and a full-width painted frame holding a centered 785px mockup, with sections separated by 96px. The rhythm alternates text and picture rather than columns, and the page uses no feature grids or pricing tables. The footer is dark and painted, with four outlined step pills and three mono-capped link columns (COMPANY, RESOURCES, CONNECT). At 375px, use the 30px heading as the display size, 64px section gaps, single-column frames and 24px side gutters. Overall density: comfortable.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #fbfdf6 (Linen Canvas)
- card surface: #f8f9f5 (Paper Card)
- headline text: #0a1d08 (Forest Ink)
- body text: #6b7860 (Sage Caption)
- UI text: #2e4320 (Moss Text)
- hairline: #2e43201a (Moss Hairline)
- status: #2b6b5e (Pine Signal) and #991e4b (Ember Signal)
- primary action: #203b14 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts default to #e9ede9 Sage Wash bars and Moss Text at 40% opacity for sparklines. #2b6b5e and #991e4b may appear only as 1 to 2px strokes, small dots, or 12%-opacity fills that mark pass and fail states, so data never outshouts the 53px headline.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an inline-flex anchor 32px tall with 0 14px padding, background #203b14, text #fbfdf6, no border, border-radius 20px, and no shadow. Set the label in Fragment Mono 400 at 14px, uppercase, line-height 1.0 and letter-spacing 0.28px. For the hero variant, raise the height to 40px with the same 20px radius. Place a ghost twin 8px to the right with a transparent background, a 1px solid #c5ccb6 border, #2e4320 text and identical type and radius.

2. Build a hero section on #fbfdf6, max-width 1280px, two columns. In the left 640px column, stack these items. First, a pill tag with background #e9ede9, text #2e4320, Fragment Mono 400 11px uppercase with 1.1px letter-spacing, 4px 8px padding and a 9999px radius. Second, 24px below it, an H1 in Akkurat 400 at 53px with line-height 1.21, letter-spacing -2.12px and color #0a1d08. Third, 24px below the headline, a paragraph in Akkurat 400 18px with line-height 1.44, color #6b7860 and max-width 640px. Fourth, 40px below the paragraph, the primary and ghost pills. In the right 400px column, render a grid of random punctuation in Fragment Mono 400 at 9px with line-height 1.11, letter-spacing 0.09px and color #2e4320 at 40% opacity.

3. Build a feature section. Start with a left-aligned H2 in Akkurat 400 at 30px with line-height 1.16, letter-spacing -0.6px and color #0a1d08. Add a 12px gap, then an 18px #6b7860 lede capped at 746px. Below it, 24px down, place a 1280px-wide frame with a 6px radius and a landscape oil-painting background image. Center a 785×615px card on it with background #f8f9f5, a 12px radius, 0 padding, and box-shadow `0 0 0 1px rgba(52,79,49,0.07), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9), 0 12px 32px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2), 0 4px 10px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)`. Inside the card, rows use 6px 8px padding with 1px #2e43201a dividers, and the bottom status bar is #1d2226 with #d8e3dd Fragment Mono 9px text.

4. Build a sticky navigation bar 64px tall with background #fbfdf6, no border and no shadow, with inner content capped at 1280px. Place an 18px-tall #0a1d08 wordmark on the left. On the right, add the links DOCS and BLOG in Fragment Mono 400 14px uppercase with 0.28px letter-spacing, color #2e4320 and 8px 12px padding, then a 32px-tall pill with background #203b14, text #fbfdf6, 0 14px padding and a 20px radius.

## Chlorophyll Neutrals

The discipline is that every neutral carries green. Canvas #fbfdf6, card #f8f9f5, wash #e9ede9, caption #6b7860, ink #0a1d08 and even the 10%-alpha hairline all lean toward moss. Most product sites anchor on Tailwind-style cool grays, and Adaline's gray scale is a foliage scale instead. Three things break it: a cool slate caption, a pure #000000 heading, or a default browser-blue focus ring. Any of these lands as a foreign object, because the eye has calibrated to warmth. To extend the system, derive new neutrals by shifting lightness along the #2e4320 to #fbfdf6 axis, or by applying #2e4320 at a new alpha such as 20% or 55%. That keeps hue identical, so every new layer inherits the tint without being specified. This treatment is the system's non-negotiable foundation.

## Monospace Instrumentation

Fragment Mono outnumbers Akkurat 618 to roughly 430. It owns every control, label, readout and footer heading, while the sans keeps only prose and headlines. The discipline is a clear division of labor: sans for statements, mono for anything you press or read as data. It breaks when a designer sets buttons in Akkurat for warmth, sets a headline in mono for a techy flavor, or drops letter-spacing to 0 on 9px caps so the narrow glyphs clot into gray. To extend it, give any new interactive or metadata element Fragment Mono at 9, 11 or 14px with tracking between 0.01em and 0.1em. Uppercase plus 0.1em tracking is reserved for section labels. New prose blocks stay in Akkurat 400 at 18px, so the two voices stay distinct.

## Painted Backdrops

Color volume lives in artwork, not in tokens. The two saturated system hues total about 120 uses, all at badge scale, while the painted canyon and snowfield frames carry every warm gold, lavender and sky blue on the page. This arrangement lets the UI stay austere while the page still feels lush. It breaks if those painting colors are sampled into buttons or headings, if the frames gain heavy shadows that compete with the mockup card, or if a synthetic gradient replaces the brushwork. To extend it, commission or license more painted landscapes that share a palette temperature. Frame each one at 1280px with a 6px radius and no stroke, and always float a #f8f9f5 instrument on top, so the art serves as habitat rather than subject.

## Similar Brands

- **Cursor** — Cursor also floats dense product UI over impressionist landscape paintings. Adaline goes further by tinting its whole neutral scale green to match the artwork.
- **Braintrust** — This category competitor in agent evals shares the mono-labeled score tables and pass/fail chips. Braintrust runs on cooler grays and a louder accent.
- **Langfuse** — Langfuse shares the trace-list and observability-mockup vocabulary of timestamps, costs and spans. Adaline wraps it in a warmer, slower editorial frame.
- **Resend** — Resend shares monospace uppercase buttons and a single near-black pill CTA. Adaline swaps Resend's dark canvas for green-tinted linen.
- **Vercel** — Vercel shares the pairing of a neutral grotesk with a companion mono and hairline-ring elevation. Vercel's grays are achromatic where Adaline's are botanical.
